variants.text:
#KC potential

units metal
boundary p p p
atom_style full
box tilt large
read_data struct.inp.data

pair_style hybrid/overlay rebo rebo kolmogorov/crespi/z 16.0
pair_coeff * * rebo 1 CH.rebo C NULL
pair_coeff * * rebo 2 CH.rebo NULL C
pair_coeff 1 2 kolmogorov/crespi/z  CC.KC   C C

neighbor	3.0 nsq
neigh_modify one 4096

thermo_modify format float %18.18g
fix 2 all lineforce 0.0 0.0 1.0

min_style cg
min_modify dmax 0.005
minimize 1.0e-18 1.0e-18 30000 30000  # 15000

write_dump all xyz system.xyz modify element C C
